FOR SOME TIME I WAS LOST IN CONJECTURE AS TO THE CAUSE OF THIS, BUT YESTERDAY AN IDEA STRUCK ME, AND IF IT IS WELL FOUNDED, I CONJURE YOU TO AVOW IT. YOU, PERHAPS, REGARD HER AS YOUR SISTER, WITHOUT ANY WISH THAT SHE MIGHT BECOME YOUR WIFE.
